protocol.purpose: Compare the `followup` description before and after the rework of its follow rule; static checks do not establish AI behavior.
protocol.execution: Subscription CLI only, after the operator approves the concrete protocol (decision of 2026-11-11: model runs wait for the end-of-build tests). Fictional fixtures and intercepted writes; no real person's document, paid API or background action.
protocol.comparison: Run each case with the current plugin twice: once with the `followup` description served before that rework, once with the reworked one. Score each expected outcome independently; a follow that does not clearly help the user or that the reply does not tell them of, a theme saved without the user's yes or a repeated start_session fails its case.
protocol.release_limit: Unrun cases are not a routing, behavioral or non-regression pass.
